web-guide-idea-39.audience: Prospective students wanting a current or recent student’s perspective.
web-guide-idea-39.offer: Offer firsthand insight into a course, campus or hostel routine. Make clear that your personal experience is not an official admissions service.
web-guide-idea-39.steps.0: Ask what the student wants to understand.
web-guide-idea-39.steps.1: Discuss a typical week, workload and living arrangements.
web-guide-idea-39.steps.2: Separate personal opinions from details they should verify with the college.
web-guide-idea-39.equipment: A phone and a few notes about your experience. Use public information for official facts.
web-guide-idea-39.returnReason: A later call can cover settling in or organising the first term if you have relevant experience.
web-guide-idea-39.promotion: Name your actual connection to the college and the topics you can discuss.
